acceptance.text: `GET /` returns 200 with `Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8`; each bookmark appears as `TITLE`, newest first
with no bookmarks the page contains the text `No bookmarks yet.`
a bookmark whose title is `<script>alert(1)</script>` is rendered as `<script>alert(1)</script>`, and the page contains no raw `<script>` tag; `&` in a url is rendered as `&`

the page contains `<form method="post" action="/bookmarks">` with inputs named `url` and `title`; posting valid form data (`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`) returns 303 with `Location: /` and stores the bookmark; invalid data returns 400 with an HTML page that shows the validation message, and stores nothing
`tests/test_page.py` exists, covers AC-F3-1 to AC-F3-4, and passes under `verify_tests`; demo target `GET /` returns 200 under `verify_run`

intent: A server-rendered page at / that lists the bookmarks as links and has a form to add one. It reuses the API's validation and data access, and must escape everything a visitor typed.
title: Bookmarks page
